## Cyrus: AI mod studio, report

Cyrus is built and committed on branch `feature/cyrus-modbuilder` (worktree `/tank/nxeon-wt-cyrus`). Nothing is merged or deployed. It lives at `/dashboard/cyrus` and `/dashboard/cyrus/[id]`, behind the same `requireModBuilderUser()` gate as the old builder. The old `/dashboard/mod-builder` still works unchanged; I checked it with screenshots. Preview users see "Cyrus · PREVIEW" in the sidebar next to "Mod Builder · PREVIEW". tsc is clean and tests pass (23/23 for `test/cyrus.test.ts` plus `test/modbuilder-gate.test.ts`).

**One thing does not work yet: the AI never sees pasted images.** The build service has no image input. Images are uploaded, stored, shown back and kept with the version, and the UI says so to the customer.

### Commits (on top of main, which now includes the Valheim self-heal)
- `29bb4e6cce` WIP checkpoint (everything up to the restart)
- `e14e4c3973` merge of main
- `43deb7c311` round 3 fixes and tests
- `2b24eec9d4` merge of `feature/mod-builder-preview` (tuning commits 180cfd13a0 and 9fcd229de0); the only conflict was in the docs. Also sends the chosen model as the service's `tier`.
- `47cc3b19ed` mobile fixes and the docs section

### What I built
- **Several projects at once.** A projects rail grouped into "Weaving now", "Favourites" and "All". Each project has its own little star-map icon and a live progress ring. On phones the rail becomes a horizontal switcher. All running builds are polled, and a toast appears when one finishes while you're looking at another.
- **Thinking animation.** One small canvas, no libraries. The network changes shape with the real build stage:
  - planning: pulses racing along the threads
  - writing code: a lattice
  - compiling: spinning rings
  - fixing: a rose "fault" node
  - safety check: a radar sweep
  - success: a bloom
  - failure: a dim, loose web

  Every real "Wrote X / Edited X" build event appears as a new labelled node. The aurora tint also follows the stage. It respects reduced-motion, pauses when off-screen, and has its own light-theme colours.
- **Prompt box.**
  - A rotating neon rim around the border.
  - Images by paste, drag-drop or file pick, shown as thumbnails.
  - Voice typing with a live waveform driven by the real mic level, and a clear message where the browser doesn't support it or blocks the mic.
  - Model picker (Katara / Saka / Yakko with a token-spend meter).
  - Game picker (Minecraft live; Valheim, Rust, Terraria, Palworld and ARK shown as "coming soon", no logos) and a version picker.
  - On phones the pickers open as bottom sheets.
- **Live code view.** The workspace shows what Cyrus is doing as it happens, within the limit below.
- **Per-mod page redesigned.**
  - Header: inline rename, favourite, Cyrus badge, Download / Install / more menu.
  - Tabs: Overview, Code, Versions, Notes.
  - A change box docked at the bottom: Enter builds the change as v(N+1) without leaving the page.
  - A failure screen for each error type, with "Try again" and "Edit and retry".
  - A Cyrus-styled install screen.
- **New features I chose:**
  - templates gallery (12 prompts, with categories)
  - "Explain this mod" in plain English
  - version map with branches, plus side-by-side or unified diff of every source file
  - "make this version current" (restore) and "branch from this version"
  - duplicate a project
  - favourites
  - autosaved per-project notes
  - keyboard shortcuts: N, P, [ ], /, V, ⌘↵, 1–4, F, ?
  - cost and time estimate before building, with a model suggestion
- **Future hooks only (no backend):** the Cyrus badge, a disabled "Publish to NxLabs · soon" button, and a "coming soon" card for the server Mods tab and community.

### What's real and what isn't
- **Real:** all data, polling, create / change / cancel, install, download, source, diff, notes, favourites, restore and uploads.
- **Live code is file names only during the build.** The service shares each file's name the moment it's written, but contents only once the build finishes. So files appear live in the tree, the code area shows a labelled placeholder, and the real code is revealed at the end. For a change, the previous version's real code is shown with the files being edited marked. If the service ever shares files mid-build, the pane already picks them up.
- **The estimate is a heuristic.** It's based on the Phase 0 measurements and is always labelled "estimate"; nothing is charged in the preview.
- **Screenshots used a local mock of the build service.** The mock replays real build records, sources and jars, fetched read-only (GETs only, the build VM was not changed).

### Backend changes (all additive)
- **Model (`tier`).** The create endpoint takes an optional `model` and sends it on as `tier: katara|saka|yakko`, the field your tuning work added. I checked against the mock that the service receives `"tier":"katara"`. A change keeps its base version's model unless a new one is picked. Following your note, Katara's copy is "Fast, for simple mods" / "Usually spends fewer tokens", not "always cheaper".
- **New database field.** One optional `ModBuild.cyrus` JSON column. **Deploying needs an additive `prisma db push`.**
- **Images.**
  - New upload endpoint `POST /api/mod-builder/uploads`: checks the real file type, 5 MB limit, rate-limited. Unused uploads are cleaned up after 24 h.
  - New owner-only image endpoint `GET /api/mod-builder/builds/[id]/attachments/[n]`.
- **Project settings.** New endpoint `PATCH /api/mod-builder/projects/[id]` for name, favourite, notes and current version.
- **Live source caching.** The source endpoint no longer caches files of builds that are still running, so live views stay current.
- The docs section is under "Cyrus: AI mod studio concept" in `docs/DOCUMENTATION.md`.

### Best screenshots (`/root/agent-notes/cyrus/best/`)
1. `1-live-build-coding-desktop.png`: live build, lattice with labelled file nodes and the workspace
2. `2-repairing-desktop.png`: fixing stage with the fault node
3. `3-home-dark-desktop.png` / `3b-home-light-desktop.png`: home in dark and light
4. `4-voice-images-composer-desktop.png`: listening waveform, image thumbnails, estimate, model hint
5. `5-model-picker-desktop.png`
6. `6-versions-diff-desktop.png`: version map and a real v1→v2 diff (+271/−40)
7. `7-success-overview-light-desktop.png`
8. `8-live-build-mobile.png` (plus `9-model-sheet-mobile.png`)

Every round is in `r1`–`r4` (1440 and 390, dark and light), including queued, failed (refused, compile, cancelled), install, palette, shortcuts, notes, empty, and another user getting a 404. The scripts are `shot.mjs` and `flow.mjs` (a full flow: type → attach → model → voice → build → watch → reveal).

### Design rounds
- **Round 1:** the rim also wrapped the message under the prompt box, so I moved it onto its own box. The network behind the headline was too busy, so I masked the centre. Fixed a hydration error from rounding in the icons.
- **Round 2:** the live build view was too cramped at 1440 (stage labels collided), so it now adapts to the panel's actual width. Files already written show "done" instead of "writing". Added a backdrop behind the event stream so it reads over the animation. Added a small network behind the plain-English card. On failure the stage box repeated the error card, so I folded the animation into the card. Made the version map bigger and added a legend.
- **Round 3:** on phones the docked change box covered the build, so it's no longer pinned there. Fixed a toast firing for the build you were already viewing. "Describe something else" on a refused build now opens the new-mod box. The change box is hidden when there is nothing to change yet. Fixed the mobile header wrapping.
- **Round 4:** on phones the model sheet drew underneath the templates, so it now opens above them; it also sat behind the portal's bottom nav, so I moved it up. Tightened the stage headline line height. Re-shot every state in light and on mobile.

### Decisions for you
1. Deploy needs the additive `prisma db push` for `ModBuild.cyrus`.
2. Should the service read reference images (the upload ids are ready to forward), and should it expose the in-progress workspace so code can stream during the build (a small change to the `/source` handler in `services/modbuilder/server.js`)?
3. Real pricing or credits per model; the estimate figures are placeholders until then.
4. Sharing a read-only link was left out on purpose: it needs a public route outside the preview gate, so I'd like your call on that.
5. Cyrus vs the old Mod Builder: which one goes forward?

### Cleanup
- I stopped the dev server and the mock service by PID and dropped the throwaway database `nxeon_agt_cyrus`.
- The worktree has a gitignored `.env` and a local `.cyrus-local/` folder (excluded from git: seed, mock, fixtures). The fixtures are copies of your real Phase 0 builds' records, sources and jars, so you may want to delete that folder.
- I added `.cyrus-local/` to the shared git exclude file, `/opt/nxeon/.git/info/exclude`.
- `node_modules` is symlinks plus its own generated Prisma client and is not committed.
- The light-theme check script isn't on main yet (`fix/portal-light-mode`), so I couldn't run it. The light theme was checked with screenshots instead; Cyrus uses scoped CSS variables, not hard-coded colour classes.
